sentences.text: An afternoon set aside for a task you know well can look like plenty of room.
sentences.note: Borderline perception scene, accepted: illustrates I1 'highlights where expectations outpace available capacity' and stays a possibility ('can').

sentences.text: With Saturn squaring your natal Sun, even that task can take more effort than usual, and if it fills the whole afternoon, anything else needs hours that are already spoken for.
sentences.note: C1 'transiting saturn square natal sun'; I1 'more deliberate effort than usual' and 'expectations outpace available capacity'. 'can' and the if-clause each stay on their own claim; 'feel demanding' and 'deliberate' are compressed.

sentences.text: If other projects are competing for those hours, with notes on one idea and a tab open on another, you may not need to decide between them this afternoon: following more than one line of curiosity can help a direction take shape.
sentences.note: N1 curiosity verbatim; 'may be different stages' carried as 'may not need to decide'. Lost condition: 'free afternoon' becomes hours already spoken for. Notes and tab stay inside the condition.

sentences.text: A note can keep an idea in view without promising it the afternoon.
sentences.note: N1 hold (an idea kept without being chosen) and I1 'clearer boundaries' carried implicitly: the afternoon is not promised to the idea.

sentences.note: Lost condition, as B1 paragraph 2 sentence 1.

sentences.text: And if an earlier way of handling the task no longer fits, you could use this return to try one smaller change: a clear point where the task stops, with the other ideas waiting as notes.
sentences.note: P2 'If an earlier way of handling this no longer fits, this return offers a chance to try a smaller adjustment to a method or boundary': condition, 'could' and 'smaller' kept. I1 'clearer boundaries' and N1 hold. No failed attempt asserted.

lostConditions: Paragraph 2 sentence 2: N1's 'If several possible projects compete for the same free afternoon' becomes 'If more than one piece is competing for the afternoon', the afternoon paragraph 1 says the task may fill; 'free' is lost and 'several possible projects' become pieces of the one growing task.

sentences.text: The notes for a task you know well can start turning into an outline.
sentences.note: I2 'take on a larger piece of work'; I1 'An established role'. Possibility kept.

sentences.text: With Jupiter trining your natal Mars, the notes and your interest in them can feed each other when the aim is well chosen, and adding the next piece can feel natural.
sentences.note: C2 'transiting jupiter trine natal mars'; I2 'reinforce one another when an aim is well chosen' and 'making it natural to take on a larger piece of work'. Condition kept on the reinforcement clause. 'or pursue an emerging opening' not carried (narrowing).

sentences.text: With Saturn squaring your natal Sun, though, the task itself can take more effort than usual, and if it fills the whole afternoon, the next piece needs hours that are already spoken for.
sentences.note: 'though' only connects two supported claims and carries no S1 meaning. 'the next piece' comes from sentence 2, and paragraph 1 cites I2.

sentences.text: This is the second of three calculated contacts; the first exact contact falls in September 2026.
sentences.note: Exact copy of A1, once, paragraph 1.

sentences.text: A bigger task can need more structure to carry it, however easy starting feels, and that need can show up where the task grows past what it was set up for.
sentences.note: S1 'Giving a plan more scope can increase the structure needed to carry it' and 'growing beyond its agreed limits offers one place to notice that tension'. 'however easy starting feels' restates the I2 ease from paragraph 1 sentence 2 (not a pass criterion).

sentences.text: If more than one piece is competing for the afternoon, you may not need to decide between them yet: following more than one line of curiosity can help a direction take shape.
sentences.note: N1 curiosity verbatim; stages kept with 'may'. Lost condition: 'free' dropped and possible projects become pieces of the task.

sentences.text: And if an earlier way of handling the task no longer fits, you could use this return to try one smaller change: the next piece can wait as a note instead of joining the outline.
sentences.note: P2 condition, 'could' and 'smaller' kept; I1 boundary; N1 hold; S1 limit context. No outcome promised.

sentences.text: An extra check can look like almost nothing next to a task you know well.
